instrument: Fender American Professional Stratocaster, passive V-Mod SSS
selector: Free-Way 5B5-01, B004, SSS Parallel Series Scheme B 1V/1T
controls: 250k master volume and 250k master tone. The middle pot is outside the signal path. Verify any separate ground junction there.

sources.title: Free-Way 5B5-01 3-pickup/2-pot manufacturer schematics
sources.scope: The supplied PDF was checked. Page 2 is B004 Scheme B 1V/1T for passive SSS. Page 1 is B002 Scheme A and page 3 is B006 HSS. Use the front view to identify pickup combinations and the reverse view to identify solder terminals.

locations: Page 2, front-view charts for positions 1–5 and 6–10

verification_needed: Use the B004 page and the actual switch markings before mapping terminals.
Check both banks against the front-view position chart and use the reverse view for the solder terminals.
Review pickup return routing and grounding against B004, including shielding and switch metalwork.
Verify both master controls and all ten positions. Check whether the unused middle pot has any connection into the signal path.
